entries.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
entries.summary: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Giants but will serve as the team's emergency quarterback.

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: According to coach Brian Schottenheimer, Ferguson (knee) is in line to miss multiple weeks, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: Wayne (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jauan Jennings
entries.summary: Jennings (calf) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Green Bay.

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs underwent surgery on his fractured right ring finger Friday and "should be back in the next few weeks," Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Josh Whyle
entries.summary: Whyle (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: Walker (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Jordan Schultz of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) is inactive for Sunday's contest against the Buccaneers.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Murray (hamstring) was ruled out for Sunday's contest in Green Bay.

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: Harrison (hamstring) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Dallas, Nick Wagoner of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Darnold (quadriceps), who won't play this coming Sunday at Las Vegas, is expected to return in Week 12 at San Francisco on Sunday, Nov. 29 after a Week 11 bye, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: Hockenson (wrist) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Green Bay.

entries.name: Thomas Fidone II
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that Henderson (illness) is working hard to get back, while acknowledging that he doesn't have a timetable for when that may occur, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

entries.name: Tyler Goodson
entries.summary: Goodson sustained ACL and MCL sprains in his knee during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts, a source tells Todd Archer of ESPN.com.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: Shavers (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: Branch (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Bell (knee) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Colts.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (knee/ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills after he was a full participant in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
entries.summary: St. Brown (ribs) was a limited participant in Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots in Munich, Germany, Tim Twentyman of the Lions' official site reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (hamstring) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Cameron Latu
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns, while Woody Marks (knee) doesn't have an injury designation.

entries.name: Davis Allen
entries.summary: Allen (oblique) is questionable for Sunday's game against Arizona, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston (toe), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN,  is trending in the right direction ahead of the contest.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (back) is questionable to play against the Seahawks on Sunday, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Garrett Wilson
entries.summary: Wilson (concussion) has one more step to complete in concussion protocol, and Jets coach Aaron Glenn believes that will happen before Sunday's game against the Bills, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Jaydn Ott
entries.summary: Ott (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Addison is listed as questionable for Sunday's game in Green Bay due to a thumb injury.

entries.name: Keaton Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (hip) remained limited at practice Friday.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (back) didn't practice Friday.

entries.name: Luther Burden III
entries.summary: Burden has a concussion, head coach Ben Johnson revealed after Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Cooper (ankle), who was a full participant in Friday's practice, is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
entries.summary: Stevenson (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Sione Vaki
entries.summary: Vaki (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots in Munich, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars after upgrading to full practice participation Friday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Miami.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against Pittsburgh.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams (hamstring) returning after the Nov. 25 against the Packers "is a realistic timeline for us," Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Njoku (fibula), who is still on IR, was limited in practice Friday.

entries.name: Demond Claiborne
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Claiborne (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

entries.name: Dyami Brown
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Gardner Minshew II
entries.summary: Minshew (elbow) will undergo UCL surgery and is out for the season, Theo Mackie of AzCentral reports.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: The Cardinals designated Long (knee) for return from injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at New Orleans after being limited in practice throughout the week, Kassidy Hill of the Panthers' official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (back) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: The Dolphins hope Willis (abdomen) will return this year but haven't ruled out season-ending surgery, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) is warmed up with his teammates Thursday, though he remains on IR and wasn't wearing a helmet, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Michael Wilson
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Wilson (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Mo Alie-Cox
entries.summary: Alie-Cox (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Abby Halpin of the Colts' official site reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: The Rams placed Nacua (knee) on injured reserve Thursday.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday during his appearance on the "Coach McVay Show" that he remains optimistic Ferguson (hamstring/ankle) will return from injured reserve this season, though he was unwilling to guarantee that the tight end will be activated by the time his 21-day evaluation window closes, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports. "I'm reluctant to get too far ahead of anything, just because -- but yes, that is something we'd want to avoid if he's not prepared," McVay said, regarding the possibility of Ferguson being shut down.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: The Saints are expected to activate Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's NFC South tilt against the Panthers, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Legette (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at New Orleans.

entries.name: Zavier Scott
entries.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
